TWO mechanisms compete at this seam. (A) UP: boundary.seam_gap_up_prior_on_worsening_cot - managed-money net -134,426, 1y pctile 0.94, 3y 2.23, WoW -38,123 worsening, a 1-year record crowded short entering a weekend, plus an unrealized bullish heat ramp (first hard_cool of the block, D0 10.9 -> D+1 12.5) crossing the closure, plus a collapsing storage surplus. I RESOLVE TO (B) AND HERE IS THE TIE-BREAKER: mechanism (A) is backed by the SAME COT REPORT that already backed my 05-29 seam call - 05-26 positions, published 05-29 15:30 - and there is NO new WoW delta between the two seams. Firing covering-UP at a second consecutive weekend seam off one unrefreshed delta is exactly the G17 0424 error that E's own lens was rewritten to prevent (0417 covering was spent, 0424 should have resumed DOWN; called +250, actual -380). What HAS refreshed since the last seam is a fresh one-sided sell run (06-03 + 06-04 = -8,514 lots, the heaviest two-session sell of the block) - which is half of covering_giveback_self_limiting's fresh-stack exception, not the whole of it, since the COT half is absent.
